changelog: Added Settings Search: top-bar icon toggling real-time search across all settings sections and sub-pages.
Added Two-Level Jarvis Voice Selection: choose language/locale first, then pick specific voice models and variants.
Added Background-Only Task Notifications: completion alerts only trigger when app is backgrounded, using the app icon.
Added Expandable Quote Preview: drag handle pill in the chat input bar to expand long quotes up to 220dp.
